PluginData.Author: Zeo-Corps
PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.3 — Resizable tactical HUD and configurable Quick Refill shortcut.
PluginData.Description: Zeo Core 1.0.3 adds a configurable Quick Refill key and modifier in HOME > AMMO. Press once to refill docked ship ammo to WANT targets and fill working tanks; press again to cancel. Unbound by default. Includes independent HUD width/height resizing with fitted text, tactical markers, scope, ship and ammo status, fleet roster, Battle Manager sharing, and hidden distress GPS across received sectors. Windows / Pulsar Legacy.
